identity_evidence.quote: A 55-year-old male, with untreated HIV, presented for evaluation of newly diagnosed plasma cell malignancy.

attribution_limitations: CD4 cell count is printed as 128 in the abstract but as 124 in the case presentation, once "at admission" and once restated in the hospitalization paragraph without its own time. The one-character difference is treated as a print artefact (ambiguity, not a source conflict); the case-text value 124 at admission is the recorded fact and the untimed restatement is not recorded as a second measurement.

Lytic lesions: the outside CT and the PET-CT describe lytic lesions, while the institute bone survey did not reveal evidence of lytic lesions. These are different modalities and are recorded as separate observations, not as a conflict.
The colonoscopy lesion size (1.5 cm x 1.5 cm) and the endoscopic ultrasound mass size (3.2 cm x 2.7 cm) come from different examinations and are not stated to be the same measurement.

The remission time is anchored to "initiation of treatment" without naming whether this is bortezomib-CHOP or antiretroviral treatment; the two treatments are both described as started, so the anchor is kept literal.

Liver-biopsy and flow-cytometry markers other than CD38 are not linked to the lymphoma tumor record: the liver masses are never stated to be plasmablastic lymphoma and the flow-cytometry specimen is not named. FNA markers are linked because the abstract identifies the FNA-sampled lesion as plasmablastic lymphoma.
